findings.body: Behavior change: `sort()` lost its numeric comparator, so it now sorts lexicographically and reorders scores (e.g. 10 sorts before 2). Restore `(a, b) => a - b`.

hotspots.reason: The refactor dropped the sort comparator, silently changing the result ordering.

evidence: src/lib/report.ts: the extraction is equivalent, but sort() lost its numeric comparator, changing output ordering.
